questions.question: What will be the output of the following pseudocode?
questions.code:
Integer x, y, val
Set x = 15, y = 25, val = 0
if(x > 10)
    if(y > 20)
        Set val = x + y
    else
        Set val = x - y
    End if
else
    Set val = x * y
End if
Print val
questions.explanation: x (15) > 10 is True. In the inner block, y (25) > 20 is True. Result val = 40.

questions.question: What will be the output of the following pseudocode?
questions.code:
Integer x, y, res
Set x = 40, y = 10
if(x + y > 60)
    Set res = (x + y) / 2
else if(x > y)
    Set res = x - y
else
    Set res = y - x
End if
Print res
questions.explanation: Sum x + y = 50. Checking conditions in order: 50 > 60 is False, 40 > 10 is True. Corresponding branch evaluates to 30.

questions.question: What will be the output of the following pseudocode?
questions.code:
Integer x, y, ans
Set x = 18, y = 18
if(x mod 2 EQUALS 0 AND y mod 2 EQUALS 0)
    Set ans = x + y
else if(x mod 2 NOT EQUALS 0 AND y mod 2 NOT EQUALS 0)
    Set ans = x * y
else
    Set ans = x - y
    if(ans < 0)
        Set ans = -ans
    End if
End if
Print ans
questions.explanation: x mod 2 = 0, y mod 2 = 0. Matching condition branch yields 36.
